canonical_project: Africa Data Centres CPT1 (Diep River / De Waal Road)

location.subnational: Western Cape - City of Cape Town

notes: ADC Cape Town CPT1 at Diep River/De Waal Road: ~5.5MW original power, R5.5bn expansion added 6MW (~1,000 racks) live by 2024 per official announcement and Business Day; total ~11.5MW+ (some sources cite up to 20MW campus). In May 2025 ADC deployed self-cooling (dry cooling) technology at CPT1 to eliminate water usage (htxt).
